credits.overview: Melon Risk, CEO of a major American corporation, declares on social media that he will bring a diamond from Neptune to Earth. The ridiculous rumor sends the global jewelry market into a tailspin, and on the other side of the world, South Korean diamond dealer Kuhyuk has a busy and difficult day.

credits.overview: Two drunken laborers interrupt a much-awaited family trip. Every time the good-natured husband accepts their request, the wife grows more upset, and these strange people become scarier.
